pr.title: feat(inbox): Error tracking signal sources UI
pr.author: Twixes
pr.description: Adds a PostHog Error Tracking toggle to the inbox signal sources UI that controls three signal types (issue_created, issue_reopened, issue_spiking), plus dedicated error tracking signal cards and improved labeling for session replay and data warehouse sources.

affected_routes.description: Actionable reports automatically generated from user session analysis and other signals
Debug query interface including signal graph and detail panel for inspecting signals
